meeting.title: Loop Returns — dbt modeling working session
meeting.summary: Technical working session on Loop's returns models. Walked through fct_returns, agreed the first metrics block, a compiled-SQL review, and a staging backfill for exchange_type.
action_items: Casey to open PR adding metrics block (return_rate, refund_total) to fct_returns.yml by June 1
Theo to review PR and validate compiled SQL in the dev project by June 2
Dev to backfill exchange_type column in the staging model by May 29
key_decisions: First metrics ship on fct_returns: return_rate and refund_total
exchange_type nulls are backfilled before metrics go live, not coalesced in the metric
meeting.notes: Pairing session in a shared screen; Loop's analytics engineers are comfortable in dbt, minimal hand-holding needed.

transcript.speaker: Theo Okonkwo
transcript.text: Sharing my screen — this is your fct_returns model compiled in our dev project. Let's define the first metrics on top of it.

transcript.speaker: Casey Morgan
transcript.text: The two the leadership team asks for every week are return rate and total refund value. If those two are self-serve we've already won.

transcript.speaker: Theo Okonkwo
transcript.text: Then those are our first metrics block. return_rate as returned orders over total orders, refund_total as a simple sum — both defined in the .yml, next to the model.

transcript.speaker: Casey Morgan
transcript.text: I want to write that myself so the team learns the workflow. I'll add the metrics block to fct_returns.yml — return_rate and refund_total — and open the PR by Monday, June 1st.

transcript.speaker: Theo Okonkwo
transcript.text: Perfect. And I'll review the PR and validate the compiled SQL in the dev project by Tuesday, June 2nd, so we catch any grain mistakes before anyone builds on it.

transcript.speaker: Dev Patel
transcript.text: One data issue before you trust return_rate — exchange_type is null for everything before March. Exchanges will be undercounted.

transcript.speaker: Theo Okonkwo
transcript.text: Good catch. Do we coalesce in the metric or fix the staging model?

transcript.speaker: Dev Patel
transcript.text: Fix it at the source — the mapping exists in the raw events, it just predates the column. I'll backfill the exchange_type column in the staging model by end of week — Friday, May 29th.

transcript.speaker: Casey Morgan
transcript.text: That's cleaner. Then my PR can assume exchange_type is trustworthy.

transcript.speaker: Theo Okonkwo
transcript.text: Agreed — Dev's backfill lands first, then the metrics PR. Anything else while we're in the model?

transcript.speaker: Casey Morgan
transcript.text: Eventually we'll want a returns-by-reason breakdown, but I don't want to scope that today.

transcript.speaker: Theo Okonkwo
transcript.text: Noted for later, not committing to it now. Good session — recap coming your way.
